challenge.method: Following SCES §§2–4 and Protocol stage 7, I reopened the original sources, checked exact revisions and passages, and tested two possible identity errors. I compared the heading with the AGPLv3 reference in §13 and checked whether §7 identifies a particular exception.
challenge.results: Section 13 names AGPLv3 as the license of another work in a combination. Section 7 describes additional permissions generally and expressly recognizes permissions confined to part of a program. Neither changes the edition identified in §0. Under SCES §5, publication separately requires supported research and independent-review outcomes for the exact revision.

limitations: The three supplied claims concern one base license and two SPDX license identifiers. None names a particular exception, inline exception grant or SPDX exception record. An exception identity, its deprecation status and its applicability to either base choice would require separate evidence.
A project or file needs its own applicable notice to establish the grant, version choice and modifications. The publisher representation alone cannot establish those facts across project files.
